short.q: Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters.
short.answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
short.working: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

short.q: Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks.
short.answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
short.working: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

short.q: Write a plan for a model house: name four rooms or things in Chinese with pinyin and write one sentence about it.
short.answer: For example 厨房 chúfáng, 客厅 kètīng, 卧室 wòshì, 床 chuáng. Sentence: 床在卧室。
short.working: 1 mark for each name with pinyin, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father."
short.answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Give three tips for neat Chinese handwriting.
short.answer: Keep characters the same size, keep strokes firm and straight, leave equal spaces, write in the right stroke order, do not join separate strokes.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
short.working: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking.
short.answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
short.working: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.

short.q: Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea."
short.answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天.
short.answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen."
short.answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 七 and 云.
short.answer: 七: qī, seven. 云: yún, cloud.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain when we use 吃 and when we use 喝.
short.answer: We use 吃 with foods to say eat, and we use 喝 with drinks to say drink.
short.working: 1 mark for each verb.

short.q: Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door."
short.answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque."
short.answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift."
short.answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 来 and 笑.
short.answer: 来: lái, to come. 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain the difference between skimming and scanning.
short.answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿.
short.answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Explain why a healthy plate should have food from several groups and name two groups with their Chinese names.
short.answer: Each group does a different job. Vegetables and fruit (蔬菜, 水果) give vitamins, rice (米饭) gives energy, and meat (肉) helps the body grow.
short.working: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 1 mark for each group named, 1 mark for the job.

short.q: Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups.
short.answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
short.working: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table."
short.answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
short.answer: I like to drink tea.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table."
short.answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 椅子 and 谁.
short.answer: 椅子: yǐzi, chair. 谁: shéi, who.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
short.working: 1 mark for each day.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期天 and 早上好.
short.answer: 星期天: xīngqītiān, Sunday. 早上好: zǎoshang hǎo, good morning.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ.
short.answer: Today it rains.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them.
short.answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
short.working: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床.
short.answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom."
short.answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见.
short.answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?"
short.answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final.
short.answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Tomorrow is Thursday."
short.answer: 明天是星期四。 míngtiān shì xīngqīsì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi.
short.answer: That is my younger brother.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin.
short.answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room."
short.answer: 客厅里有电视。 kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply.
short.answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

short.q: Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.
